decisive_spans.text: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins

response.rationale: The patient presents with classic signs of blepharitis, including scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids with crusty plaques on the eyelid margins. While ectropion is also present, the description of the eyelid margins strongly points to blepharitis as the primary diagnosis related to inflammation of the eyelid itself.
